layer_selection_caveat: the 75th-percentile layer is a hyper-parameter chosen on the SAME data; the layer_robustness block below repeats the matrix at other layers

loose.fold_protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, seed=42) on loose groups — IDENTICAL for every protocol; stratified so no class can vanish from a train fold

strict.fold_protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, seed=42) on strict groups — IDENTICAL for every protocol; stratified so no class can vanish from a train fold

permuted_label_control.protocol: loose/group_excl, labels permuted within each parameter

selectivity_caveat: supports DISCRIMINATIVE selectivity only; not functional or causal independence
